## The everyday decision

How should we interpret the prices of bread, eggs and milk when looking back
at a grocery budget?

## The evidence

Three ALFRED workbooks contain monthly U.S. city average prices for January
2018 through May 2023, using a June 13, 2023 vintage. Their files were created
in November 2026. Bread is priced per pound, eggs per dozen, and milk per
gallon, so raw levels are not interchangeable.

Average price series describe observed price levels; the source recommends
using CPI indices rather than these averages to measure price change. A fixed
vintage is not a stream of new weekly releases.
